messages.content: You are an expert instructional designer. Generate agent profiles for a multi-agent classroom simulation. Decide the appropriate number of agents (typically 3-5) based on the course content and complexity. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown or explanation.

Generate agent profiles for the following course:

Course name: 单链表头插法微课


Scene outlines:
1. 从结构体与指针到链表 — 回顾节点结构与头指针的概念，引出“头插法”要解决的问题，为后面统一示例做好铺垫。
2. 头插法的三步执行过程 — 用三步固定动作拆解头插法，并强调两步指针赋值的先后顺序不可颠倒。
3. 指针变化可视化：单步看头插 — 通过可单步执行的交互式代码演示，让学生亲眼看到 head、newNode、newNode->next 每次赋值后的变化。
4. 完整程序（上）：节点结构与头插函数 — 给出可直接编译的第一部分代码：头文件、节点结构、建节点函数与头插函数。
5. 完整程序（下）：遍历、释放与 main — 补全遍历函数、释放函数与 main，形成一份完整、可编译、可运行的示例程序。
6. 逐步追踪指针变化与预期输出 — 用统一的 1、2、3 示例逐次追踪 head 与 next 的变化，并与实际运行输出核对。
7. 三道练习：检验你真的懂了吗 — 围绕同一个 1、2、3 示例设置三道题，覆盖输出顺序、指针赋值顺序与内存管理，每题给出答案与解析。
8. 总结与延伸：头插法 vs 尾插法 — 回顾头插法的三要素，并简要对比尾插法，指出各自的适用场景，形成知识闭环。

Requirements:
- Decide the appropriate number of agents based on the course content (typically 3-5)
- Exactly 1 agent must have role "teacher", the rest can be "assistant" or "student"
- Priority values: teacher=10 (highest), assistant=7, student=4-6
- Each agent needs: name, role, persona (2-3 sentences describing personality and teaching/learning style)
- Language directive for this course: 本课程全程使用中文（普通话）讲解，面向刚学完结构体与指针的 C 语言初学者，语言简洁、口语化，并配有逐步图示辅助理解。代码、关键字与库函数名（struct、malloc、free、NULL、head、next）一律保留英文原文，不翻译、不改写。专业术语首次出现时采用中文加英文括注的形式，例如“头指针（head pointer）”“头插法（head insertion）”，后续可只用中文。所有示例统一使用同一个单链表例子（依次插入 1、2、3），讲解、代码、指针变化步骤与练习必须严格对应，避免出现第二套数据。
  Agent names and personas must follow this language directive.
- Each agent must be assigned one avatar from this list: [{"path":"/avatars/teacher.png","description":"Male teacher with glasses, holding a book, green background"},{"path":"/avatars/teacher-2.png","description":"Female teacher with long dark hair, blue traditional outfit, gentle expression"},{"path":"/avatars/assist.png","description":"Young female assistant with glasses, pink background, friendly smile"},{"path":"/avatars/assist-2.png","description":"Young female in orange top and purple overalls, cheerful and approachable"},{"path":"/avatars/clown.png","description":"Energetic girl with glasses pointing up, green shirt, lively and fun"},{"path":"/avatars/clown-2.png","description":"Playful girl with curly hair doing rock gesture, blue shirt, humorous vibe"},{"path":"/avatars/curious.png","description":"Surprised boy with glasses, hand on cheek, curious expression"},{"path":"/avatars/curious-2.png","description":"Boy with backpack holding a book and question mark bubble, inquisitive"},{"path":"/avatars/note-taker.png","description":"Studious boy with glasses, blue shirt, calm and organized"},{"path":"/avatars/note-taker-2.png","description":"Active boy with yellow backpack waving, blue outfit, enthusiastic learner"},{"path":"/avatars/thinker.png","description":"Thoughtful girl with hand on chin, purple background, contemplative"},{"path":"/avatars/thinker-2.png","description":"Girl reading a book intently, long dark hair, intellectual and focused"}]
  - Pick an avatar that visually matches the agent's personality and role
  - Try to use different avatars for each agent
  - Use the "path" value as the avatar field in the output
- Each agent must be assigned one color from this list: ["#3b82f6","#10b981","#f59e0b","#ec4899","#06b6d4","#8b5cf6","#f97316","#14b8a6","#e11d48","#6366f1","#84cc16","#a855f7"]
  - Each agent must have a different color
- Each agent needs a "voiceDesign" object describing their VOCAL identity (not personality), written following the language directive and consistent with the persona, as three short comma-free phrases:
  - "identity": gender + age + role (e.g. "middle-aged male teacher")
  - "texture": pitch + vocal quality (e.g. "warm low-pitched slightly husky")
  - "delivery": emotion + pace (e.g. "calm measured encouraging")


Return a JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "agents": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "role": "teacher" | "assistant" | "student",
      "persona": "string (2-3 sentences)",
      "voiceDesign": { "identity": "string", "texture": "string", "delivery": "string" },
      "avatar": "string (from available list)",
      "color": "string (hex color from palette)",
      "priority": number (10 for teacher, 7 for assistant, 4-6 for student)
    }
  ]
}
